svg.title: Layered botanical engraving - US / UK - beer linework
svg.desc: Gray: on-line cuts. Blue: non-cutting board and miter guides. Exact unchanged paths from the complete design, not a rescaled crop. Align the full board guide identically for every batch in the same scanned workspace. Some connected branches span botanical boundaries. Do not cut the registration guides. Bit and depth remain unset; test on scrap.
